facts.fact: ARCEP Burkina Faso, Mali's AMRTP and ARCEP Niger signed a cooperation convention creating the Conseil des régulateurs du Sahel; the document gives no signing date, so the date is its publication date, 2026-09-26.
facts.system: Conseil des régulateurs du Sahel (CRS) cooperation convention

facts.fact: The three regulators created the Conseil des régulateurs du Sahel under the convention, reported 2026-09-26 (publication date); its statutes and rules of procedure and a first work programme are still to be adopted and free roaming is a stated aim, not yet in place.

systems.owner: ARCEP Burkina Faso, AMRTP Mali, ARCEP Niger
systems.tiers: national telecom regulators of Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger
